Kinetic sand is a great way to provide sensory input while still working on a multitude of skills.  I love to use cookie cutters in the sand to work on bilateral skills, pressure and and force regulation.  Cutting with sand is a great introduction to snipping and provides additional sensory feedback. Kids who are struggling with writing tend to be more willing to practice writing on different surfaces.
